findings.title: Potential conflict with CloudSpan Technologies exclusivity (§7.1)
findings.explanation: Potential conflict — not a breach determination. CloudSpan Technologies §7.1: No implementation / reseller / referral partnership with any Competing Platform (cloud data-warehouse, lakehouse or unified analytics platform as a service) in India or the GCC. Europe was deliberately excluded. Mutual 90-day termination for convenience ends the restriction. Status: active, until 31 Aug 2028 (Term to 31 Aug 2028; either party may exit on 90 days' notice (§14.2), which lifts §7 (§14.4(b)).). The restriction binds AtliQ's Affiliates too, so signing through the other AtliQ entity does not avoid it. This contract matches every element — competing platform: lakehouse, unified analytics platform, analytics platform, data warehouse · partner appointment: referral partner, implementation partner, Implementation Partner, Premier Implementation, referral fee · India / GCC territory: India, Gulf Cooperation Council, United Arab Emirates, Saudi, GCC. Related: staffing commitment (active) — Maintain at least 4 CloudSpan Certified Engineers for the term.

evidence.quote: during the Term Partner and its Affiliates shall not act as an implementation, reseller or referral partner for any Competing Platform in India or the GCC.

findings.title: New restrictive covenant on AtliQ (term + 24 months)
findings.explanation: This clause would restrict who AtliQ can work for — and it would join the commitments register. AtliQ has no list of what it has already promised not to do outside this tool; restrictions like this are how the Al Noor GCC non-compete came to block hospitality work. Check it against current clients and pipeline before signing (see Commitments).
findings.contract_quote: During the Term and for a period of twenty-four (24) months following expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Partner shall not, and shall cause its Affiliates not to, directly or indirectly solicit, market to, or provide any implementation, migration, managed or consulting services to any Datavane Account in connection with any cloud data warehouse, lakehouse, data platform or analytics platform other than the Datavane Platform.

findings.title: AtliQ is paid only after the other party collects (pay-when-paid)
findings.explanation: Payment to AtliQ depends on the other party first receiving payment from its customer, and then a further 60 days. AtliQ carries the end customer's credit risk. Checklist: '30 days, 45 max'; Trustline was negotiated from 90 to 45 days.
findings.contract_quote: Datavane shall pay Partner's share of Joint Deal Revenue within sixty (60) days after the end of the calendar quarter in which Datavane receives payment from the relevant Datavane Account.

findings.title: Asymmetric termination — the other side can exit at will, AtliQ cannot
findings.explanation: §7.3 locks AtliQ in for the initial term, while §7.2 lets the other party walk away on short notice ("Datavane may terminate this Agreement at any time, for any reason or no reason, upon fifteen (15) days' written notice to Partner."). AtliQ's precedent for partnerships is mutual 90-day termination for convenience (CloudSpan, Aug 2025). Check also what happens to unpaid revenue share on termination.
findings.contract_quote: No Termination for Convenience by Partner. Partner acknowledges the investment made by Datavane in enabling Partner and agrees that Partner may not terminate this Agreement for convenience during the initial term.

findings.title: Uncapped liability for AtliQ under §12.3
findings.explanation: AtliQ's exposure under the cited provisions is carved out of any cap. By contrast §12.2 caps the other side's liability at TEN THOUSAND UNITED STATES DOLLARS (USD 10,000). AtliQ's position has been liability capped at 1x fees; Karandeep walked away from Kessler Mobility (~€120k) over 'liable without limitation'.
findings.contract_quote: NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT PARTNER'S LIABILITY UNDER SECTION 5, SECTION 9 OR SECTION 11.1.

findings.title: Only the other party can stop auto-renewal
findings.explanation: Renewal can be stopped only by Datavane. AtliQ has no exit at the end of the term.
findings.contract_quote: This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of three (3) years, and thereafter renews automatically for successive one (1) year periods unless Datavane gives notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term (the "Term").

findings.title: Other party can change the terms unilaterally
findings.explanation: Programme guides and portal terms updated by the other side automatically become part of the contract, without AtliQ's signature.
findings.contract_quote: Datavane may update the Global Partner Program Guide, certification requirements and Partner Portal terms from time to time upon notice to Partner, and such updates shall form part of this Agreement.

findings.title: US (Delaware) law and local courts
findings.explanation: AtliQ's default is Indian law for Pvt Ltd and US state law for Inc. US (Delaware) is the counterparty's home law, which AtliQ has accepted before when needed (English law for Northwind, DIFC for Al Noor, Singapore/SIAC for CloudSpan). Forum: Any action or proceeding arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in the state or federal courts located in the City and County (§13.2). Disputes would be run under unfamiliar law, typically needing local counsel.
findings.contract_quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
